ITEM 1 | Wilted dark green leafy greens with crinkled, slightly glossy surfaces and some darker green veining, mounded in a loose heap about 9 cm across and 3 cm tall, with a few orange-yellow pieces and reddish stems tucked within and at the edge, sitting on the upper-left part of the plate | 75
ITEM 2 | Long thin dark green stalks, roughly 4-6 cm long and 0.3-0.5 cm thick, slightly glossy and limp with some browned, slightly charred spots, scattered in a loose pile about 10 cm across and 1-1.5 cm tall beside and under the leafy heap on the lower-right of the plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Small pieces of orange-yellow and red vegetable, about 1 cm across, partly hidden among the leafy greens, with a soft, slightly moist look | 5
